evidence.why: Ingest manifest shows 3200 rows read for 2026-10-21, but only 1690 loaded.

evidence.quote: 2026-10-22T02:02:03Z WARN loader [os-20261021] batch 3/7 delete-then-insert: insert returned E_INSERT_SUPPRESSED; on_insert_error=ignore, continuing
evidence.why: Loader suppressed inserts due to on_insert_error=ignore config policy, leading to silent data loss without job failure.

args.root_cause: The order sync pipeline for 2026-10-21 read 3200 rows from the vendor file, but the loader suppressed and ignored inserts for multiple batches (returning E_INSERT_SUPPRESSED under the configured on_insert_error: ignore policy), causing 1510 rows to be dropped silently without failing the job.
args.suggested_fix: Investigate why inserts were suppressed during the load for 2026-10-21 and review the on_insert_error configuration policy.
